description: Inputs of eval.py:assemble() for the iteration-3 record audit (art_7W9xiIO3FVBs). JSON summaries are complete; per-row tables are subsets of <=100 rows (full sizes in 'full_sizes').

frame_agreement.json.id_normaliser: Exp5 int -> 'C'+int; Exp6 URL -> last path segment; idempotence asserted

home_kappa_26.note: Exp5 primary = first listed home code; Exp6 home_primary; set overlap counts any shared home field

early_volume_log.window_note: both frames: grounded works t0..t0+2 (same window, own t0 and own grounding); CCC valid as absolute agreement only where t0 agrees

rules_in_order: GROUNDING: early-volume ratio Exp5/Exp6 outside [0.5, 2] (count in year t0 is not stored; early t0..t0+2 volume used)
ONSET_RULE: counts agree but t0 differs
HOME_RULE: t0 agrees, home differs (or episode field is a home field in one frame)
EPISODE_THRESHOLD: field present in one frame with <= 3 early works (next to the shared >= 2 threshold)
RETENTION_WINDOW: shared episode, R differs but Exp5 R_abs2 equals Exp6 R_cj (definition difference)

pooling.implication: A failed Exp5-minus-Exp6 confirmation can be read as a failure of the H2 claim only if the frames agree on the retention and episode definitions. Retention kappa between Exp5 R (relative share rule) and Exp6 R_cj (absolute >= 2) is the binding criterion; with the matched absolute definition (R_abs2) the frames agree much better, so the confirmation must rebuild RETAINED/LOST on the Exp5 frame with Exp6's R_cj rule (R_abs2) before reading a null as a failure.
pooling.scope_limit: agreement is measured on the 628 shared (newborn-candidate) concepts only; Exp6's frame is not a random subset of Exp5, so it may overstate agreement for Exp5-only (mostly non-newborn) concepts

o5_definitions.json.common_conditions: year_usable == true AND t0 < year <= t0 + 8 (t0 = Exp5 frame onset)

qualifying_event_types.mesh: event_type == mesh_descriptor_introduced AND detail.mesh_baseline is not true AND year > 1966 (supplementary records mesh_supplementary_record_introduced excluded: not descriptors)
qualifying_event_types.taxonomies: acm_ccs / msc / pacs_physh event_type == taxonomy_added_between (taxonomy_in_version is a membership, not an addition date)
qualifying_event_types.curated_lists: gartner_hype_cycle, mit_tr10, nature_methods_moty, science_boty, physics_world_boty, research_fronts (any listed event)
qualifying_event_types.excluded: jel (present-day membership only, no dated events)

variants.O5_main: 1 if >= 1 qualifying event with relation == 'same' from MeSH / Wikipedia / Wikidata / taxonomy_added_between / curated lists
variants.O5_wiki: O5_main restricted to wikipedia_en + wikidata (the only sources that run in every group)
variants.O5_tax: O5_main restricted to dated taxonomies (mesh descriptor + acm_ccs/msc/pacs_physh taxonomy_added_between)
variants.O5_anyrel: O5_main with relation in {same, narrower, broader}
variants.O5_main_noRF: ADDITIONAL (declared here, before results): O5_main without research_fronts, which are citation-derived (leakage risk)
variants.O5_lag: year of the first qualifying (relation same) event minus t0, for O5_main positives

outcomes.O2r_resid: O2r_m50 residualised on log N_outcome by OLS within Exp5 split (Exp5 has no O2r_resid column)

reading_rule.RELATED_NOT_DUPLICATE: pooled rho with O2r_m50 or O1 has 95% CI > 0 and |rho| < 0.8
reading_rule.UNRELATED: pooled CI covers 0 for all of O1, O2r_m50 and O2r_resid
reading_rule.pooled: DerSimonian-Laird across the 4 held-out groups (PHYS, LIFEENV, SOC, MATHDEC), bootstrap SEs

o5_definitions.json.precedence_flag: source flagged if > 30% of matched concepts have their first usable same-relation event at or before t0
o5_definitions.json.fit_for_use_rule: positive precision >= 0.85 AND date error <= 1 year in >= 80% of checked positives (hand check)

jel.reason: present-day membership only; no dated events

taxonomy_in_version.reason: membership in a version, not an addition date

_all_main_sources.censoring: 2025 (Wikipedia/lists); MeSH 2026 cut treated as 2025 in the combined curve

results/o5_handcheck_summary.json.label: executor-checked (LLM judge + executor reading + MediaWiki first-revision API); NOT a human expert annotation
results/o5_handcheck_summary.json.fn_note: lower bound: only Wikipedia was checked for false negatives (not MeSH/taxonomies)
results/o5_handcheck_summary.json.positives_emergence_meaningful_note: executor judgement: does the event plausibly mark recognition of a NEW concept (vs dating a long-known phenomenon)?
results/o5_handcheck_summary.json.FIT_FOR_USE_rule: precision_strict >= 0.85 AND date error <= 1 year in >= 80% of checked positives

n_rows.how: rows of entry_risk_sets_heldout.parquet with n_ret > 0 (primary sample)

n_strata.how: unique strata in the primary sample (all, incl. strata with 0 events)

n_strata_model.how: strata with >= 1 event and >= 1 non-event (the only strata that enter a conditional likelihood)

se_M1_d0_ret_rel.how: inverse observed information of the Breslow refit

se_M2_d_ret_gate.how: inverse observed information of the Breslow refit

se_M2lost_d_lost_gate.how: inverse observed information of the Breslow refit

auc_within_M0.how: refit linear predictor, mean-rank AUC per informative stratum

d0_ret_rel_DL_pooled_M1.how: new: DL pooling of the plain retaining-relatedness coefficient (M1), the review's suggested headline

record_tables/next_field_trace.json.strata_clash_resolution: The hypothesis text's '961 strata' is the number of INFORMATIVE strata (>= 1 event and >= 1 non-event) that enter the conditional likelihood (961 recomputed; 18846 rows); the file's n_strata = 2,339 counts ALL strata of the primary sample (n_ret > 0; 2339 recomputed, 46433 rows). The parquet itself holds 2992 strata / 61648 rows before the n_ret > 0 restriction.
record_tables/next_field_trace.json.LR_clash_resolution: LR 68.6 = M1 (plain retaining relatedness d0_ret_rel) vs M0, Breslow; LR 71.7 = M2 (gateway-weighted d_ret_gate) vs M0, Breslow; LR 77.3 = M2 vs M0 with the exact conditional likelihood (statsmodels, Exp6 audit.json). Recomputed here: M1vsM0 Breslow 68.57 / exact 73.25; M2vsM0 Breslow 71.72 / exact 77.30.
record_tables/next_field_trace.json.d_clash_resolution: d = 0.281 is the M1 coefficient of plain retaining relatedness (d0_ret_rel, SE 0.032); d = 0.302 ('0.30') is the M2 coefficient of gateway-weighted retaining relatedness (d_ret_gate). Both are Breslow, per SD of the frozen DEV standardisation.
